prompt: The courtiers bow slowly and deeply toward the goose on the throne, and the goose turns its head to look down at them. The candle flames flicker. Slow push in toward the throne.
The same sunflower field continues to both sides, and every other sunflower faces away from the camera, showing the green backs of their heads, under the same clear sky.

An ordinary smartphone photo taken at night with the flash on: a pink flamingo stands alone under a city bus stop shelter, waiting on the wet pavement as if for the next bus, its reflection in the shelter's glass. Nobody else is there. Harsh direct flash, a dark street behind with a few blurred car lights, slight grain, ordinary phone photo quality. The flamingo stands in the centre of the frame, its head at about a third of the height from the top and its feet at about four fifths. The shelter's panels are plain and carry no words. No text, no logo.
Low sunset light in deep marigold orange from the left and a bougainvillea magenta neon glow from the right.

He has the head of a brown hare, with long upright ears, whiskers and amber eyes, on an ordinary man's body. He wears an oatmeal knitted cardigan and stands in a laundromat, holding a basket of folded towels.

Turn this camper van into a cake of the same shape, size and angle, in the same two colours. The body is sponge cake under smooth fondant in the same green and cream, the bumpers and headlights are silver sugar, the wheels are dark chocolate and the windows are clear glazed sugar. A wedge is cut from the side, showing layers of vanilla sponge and orange cream. It stands on a round cake board on the same floor, with the same light and backdrop. No text, no logo.

One unbroken shot. It opens wide on a vast field of red poppies under a clear morning sky, then the camera crash zooms fast down into the field and stops close on one honeybee on one poppy, its wings and the yellow pollen on its legs sharp.

An ordinary smartphone photo, taken from a few metres away in bright afternoon sun, of an invented woman in her late twenties with a short blond bob and a faded denim shirt, watering a small backyard garden with a green garden hose. A clear arc of water leaves the nozzle and falls on a bed of leafy plants. Slightly overexposed daylight, ordinary phone photo quality, a plain wooden fence behind her. She is seen from the head to the knees, standing a little left of centre, with her face between 30 and 45 percent of the frame's height from the top, and the arc of water crosses the middle of the frame to the plants on the right. No text, no logo.

Keep this photo exactly the same: the same woman, face, pose, hose, garden, light and framing. Change only the water. The arc leaving the hose is now a stream of flower petals in marigold orange and magenta, flying in the same arc and landing on the plants, with a few petals resting on the leaves. No water remains. No text.

A wide film still from a lavish period drama: a candlelit palace throne hall decorated with banks of flowers in marigold orange and magenta. A white goose wearing a small deep red velvet cape sits upright on the golden throne at the centre. Courtiers in silk and brocade gowns and coats stand in two rows along a red carpet and bow low toward it, played completely straight. Warm candle light, soft haze, 35mm film, shallow depth of field. The goose and the throne sit in the centre of the frame. No text.

Studio photograph of a single vintage 1960s camper van with a split windscreen, painted in two tones, cactus green below and cream above, with chrome bumpers and round headlights, parked at a three-quarter front angle on a polished concrete floor. Warm paper-coloured seamless backdrop, one large soft key light from the left and a warm rim light from behind, a soft reflection under the van. The van fills the centre of the square frame. No people, no text, no badges, no logo, no number plate.

Square photograph in a sunflower field on a summer afternoon. One sunflower in the centre of the frame turns its face fully toward the camera, its bright yellow petals and dark centre sharp. Around it, at the edges of the frame, the other sunflowers all face away from the camera, showing the green backs of their heads and their stems. A clear pale blue sky fills the top third of the frame, in soft warm sunlight. No text.

Studio photograph of a glazed ceramic sculpture of a jaguar head, life size, in pale cream glaze with fine black painted rosettes and gold leaf eyes, standing on a plain white plinth. Flat, even, overcast light from the front with no strong shadows, plain light grey backdrop. The head fills the centre of the square frame, seen from the front at eye level. No text.

Product photograph of a single faceted glass perfume bottle filled with magenta liquid, with a gold cap shaped like a closed flower bud, standing upright among dense red and pink garden roses that crowd around it and behind it. Warm side light from the left, the glass catching bright highlights and a small orange glow. The bottle stands in the centre of the square frame and fills about half its height. No text, no label, no logo.
